clips.title: The story
paras: Newly freed Forsaken awaken in Shadow Grave, above Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

Shadow Grave sits on the rocky slope above Deathknell, a stone mausoleum where the newly freed Forsaken awaken. Once raised into the Scourge’s mindless service, the dead recover their free will in its vaults. Undertaker Mordo watches over them as they rise from stone slabs and take their first steps into a world that despises them. They follow the footpath down to Deathknell and pledge themselves to the Banshee Queen.
